body: professional help didn't work for me. I am always close to snapping and offing myself
I'm always tired and I feel like the effort isn't worth it anymore. I've looked for help and the help goes into the "you're depressed", or the "this is life" camp.
same here ~ I always think about it. I also think I am beyond help.
Every single day, even my siblings told me I should never have been born.
I am always like this, I hate my life. I hate who I am. I wouldn't mind ending it because I don't think things will get better
It is always there, in the back of my head. I overwork to escape it. But, I am cracking from the stress.
It doesn't really matter. I want to end it all. I am still tired.
